latest_cos_commentary.headline: Ziosk is the long-standing pay-at-the-table tablet incumbent in casual dining, with named clients including Chili's, Texas Roadhouse, Olive Garden, and Outback Steakhouse, positioned as an add-on to existing POS rather than a replacement.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Direct overlap with Genius on tableside pos/payments and loyalty_engagement (guest engagement games), particularly in casual dining accounts.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: No dated 2025-2026 product news was found in this pass; positioning content reflects standing vendor marketing.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Where a casual-dining prospect already runs Ziosk for pay-at-table, position Genius's tableside capabilities as a way to consolidate payments and engagement into one stack rather than running a separate add-on device.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Current ownership and leadership were not verified in this pass; adoption/tip/turn-time statistics are vendor-reported aggregates.
